engine_core.description: The foundational C++/Java/Rust backend governing physics and memory.

threading_model.main_thread: Manages core game loop, input polling, and client state orchestration.
threading_model.mesh_update_thread: Asynchronously handles graphical vertex, fragment, and shader updates.
threading_model.server_thread: Executes authoritative backend logic, physics calculations, and networking.
threading_model.emerge_thread: Fetches, reads, and procedurally generates terrain and map data.

engine_core.memory_management: Smart pointers, ECS memory pools, Vulkan/OpenGL data buffers.

game_logic_layer.description: The discrete rulesets defining world behavior and entity interaction.
game_logic_layer.virtual_machine: Executes sandboxed logic securely (e.g., Native Client, LuaJIT, QuakeC).

entity_component_system.server_active_objects: Defines the mathematically authoritative state of entities (SAOs).
entity_component_system.client_active_objects: Defines the visual and interpolative representation of entities (CAOs).

game_logic_layer.spatial_partitioning: Octrees or Bounding Volume Hierarchies (BVH) for rapid collision and culling.

ui_and_hud_subsystem.description: Decoupled presentation layer for the player interface, including minimaps.
ui_and_hud_subsystem.framework: RmlUi, TeraNUI, MyGUI, or native canvas overlays.

minimap_renderer.data_ingestion: Queries active CAOs and MapBlocks via the IGameDef API without blocking.
minimap_renderer.projection_math: Orthographic matrix projection converting 3D world coordinates to a 2D plane.
minimap_renderer.raycasting_module: DDA algorithm utilized for real-time line-of-sight and fog-of-war generation.
minimap_renderer.thermal_decay_tracking: AI-driven SLAM memory buffers mapping cleared versus uncleared zones.
minimap_renderer.user_input_bindings: Keybind listeners (e.g., Shift+V for rotation locking, M for display toggle).

asset_and_module_management.description: Virtual File Systems controlling dependency injection and resource loading.
asset_and_module_management.audio_video_decoding: FFmpeg pipelines utilizing Vorbis (OGG) and Theora (OGV) codecs.

gestalt_module_system.module_config: JSON-based definition of module dependencies, versioning schemas, and metadata.
gestalt_module_system.asset_deltas: Systematic, non-destructive overriding of baseline textures and configuration sounds.

continuous_integration_pipeline.description: Automated quality assurance and build verification systems.
continuous_integration_pipeline.build_tools: CMake, Gradle (Kotlin DSL), Cargo, or Urcheon.
continuous_integration_pipeline.static_analysis: Automated code scrutiny via Clang-Tidy, Spotbugs, and Clippy.
continuous_integration_pipeline.test_suites: JUnit/GTest automated suites equipped with flaky-test isolation logic.
